description: Personal aircraft of actor and USAF Brigadier General James M. Stewart - the second of two Cessna 310s he owned; recovered engineless from Dallas Executive Airport in April 2015 by EAA Chapter 993 and restored over roughly 6500 volunteer hours; hoisted onto its pedestal 2 September 2020 and dedicated 26 September 2020; mounted banked 15 degrees and free to weathervane into wind with working nav lights; HMdb marker 288368 catalogued/last revised 11 November 2025 with on-site photography; model and 1961 build year from AOPA report dated 16 November 2020; FAA registry shows N6775X deregistered so no current FAA YEAR-MFR is exposed. Presence confirmed in current aerial imagery.
museum_name: Indiana County Jimmy Stewart Airport -- Indiana
